cases.translation: The Lord spoke to Moses on Mount Sinai.
cases.explain: Моисей is the recipient of сказал (said to) — the indirect object → dative.

cases.translation: The Lord spoke to Moses on Mount Sinai.
cases.explain: The preposition на marking location takes the prepositional → горе.

cases.sentence: …когда вы войдете в ___, которую я отдаю вам.
cases.translation: …when you come into the land which I give you.
cases.explain: The preposition в with motion (войти в) governs the accusative → землю.

cases.sentence: Пусть земля отдыхает каждый седьмой год, соблюдая ___ Господа.
cases.translation: Let the land rest every seventh year, keeping a Sabbath to the Lord.
cases.explain: Суббота is the direct object of соблюдая (keeping) → accusative; feminine -а nouns take -у.

cases.sentence: Не обманывайте друг друга, бойтесь вашего ___.
cases.translation: Do not wrong one another, but fear your God.
cases.explain: The verb бояться (to fear) governs the genitive → Бога.

cases.sentence: Я Господь ваш Бог, который вывел вас из ___.
cases.translation: I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of Egypt.
cases.explain: The preposition из (out of) always governs the genitive → Египта.

cases.sentence: Каждый из вас должен вернуться к своему ___.
cases.translation: Each of you shall return to his own property.
cases.explain: The preposition к (to/toward) always governs the dative → владению.

cases.sentence: Все, что произрастит земля в субботний год, будет вам ___.
cases.translation: Whatever the land produces in the Sabbath year shall be food for you.
cases.explain: The predicate noun after будет (will be) takes the instrumental → пищей.

reading.ru: Не засевайте поле и не обрезайте виноградник.
reading.question: In the Sabbath year, what are the people commanded NOT to do?
options: Sow the field or prune the vineyard
reading.correct: Sow the field or prune the vineyard
reading.explain: The text forbids sowing the field and pruning the vineyard in that year.

reading.ru: Землю нельзя продавать навсегда, потому что земля моя, а вы у меня чужеземцы и поселенцы.
reading.question: Why may the land not be sold permanently?
options: Because the land belongs to God
reading.correct: Because the land belongs to God
reading.explain: God says the land is His and the people are but strangers and sojourners with Him.

reading.ru: Осветите пятидесятый год и возвестите свободу по всей земле всем ее обитателям.
reading.question: What must be proclaimed throughout the land in the fiftieth year?
reading.explain: The fiftieth year is hallowed and liberty is proclaimed to all the land's inhabitants.

reading.ru: Не бери с него процентов, бойся своего Бога, чтобы твой соплеменник жил с тобой и дальше.
reading.question: What must you NOT take from an impoverished fellow countryman?
reading.explain: The text says to take no interest from him, but to fear God.

reading.ru: Израилетяне мои слуги, которых я вывел из Египта, их нельзя продавать в рабство.
reading.question: Why may the Israelites not be sold as slaves?
options: They are God's servants whom He brought out of Egypt
reading.correct: They are God's servants whom He brought out of Egypt
reading.explain: God calls them His servants whom He led out of Egypt, so they may not be sold into slavery.

reading.ru: Пусть у земли будет год покоя.
reading.question: What shall the land have?
reading.explain: The text declares a year of rest (solemn rest) for the land.
